Opening & Greetings“Good [morning/afternoon], everyone.My name is Wilson Dos Santos, and I’m a Cloud Solution Architect based in São Paulo.Today, I’m excited to share a project that’s been making a real difference in how we handle Java adapter migrations.”🎯 Purpose of the Presentation“The goal of this session is to introduce a tool we developed using .NET 8.0.This tool automates the migration of small Java adapters, helping us save time and reduce manual errors.”🧩 Setting the Context“Let me give you a bit of background.We have a number of legacy Java adapters that need to be migrated to a new architecture.Doing this manually is repetitive, time-consuming, and prone to mistakes.That’s why we built this tool—to streamline and standardize the migration process.”⚙️ How the Tool Works“Here’s how the tool works, step by step:Step 1: Configuration LoadingIt starts by reading configuration files like appsettings.json, extracting the API key and endpoint from the OpenIA41 section.Step 2: Structure DefinitionThen it defines folder and file names—like adapterFolderName and dtoPath.Step 3: Template CloningIt clones a Git repository with a base project and renames folders and files to match the new project—for example, SICTM.BFF.Conta.Step 4: AI-Powered MigrationThis is where it gets exciting.The tool uses AI to migrate resource files, configuration files like adapter.xml, and DTOs.It even generates a README.md file based on the migrated content.”🚀 Key Benefits“So, what do we gain from this?A significant reduction in migration time.Standardized, consistent code output.AI integration to assist with file transformation.And automatic documentation generation.”🔭 What’s Next“Looking ahead, we’re taking this even further:1. Rewriting the Migrator in PythonWe’re transitioning from .NET 8.0 to Python, using the Semantic Kernel SDK to orchestrate AI agents.2. Multi-Agent ArchitectureEach migration step—resources, DTOs, adapter.xml—will be handled by a specialized agent.This allows for parallel processing and scalability, handling multiple requests per second.3. Performance ImprovementsWe expect even faster migrations and better responsiveness for simultaneous adapter requests.”🙏 Closing“That’s the journey so far—and where we’re headed.Thank you so much for your time and attention.I’m happy to take any questions you might have.”
